results.note: Turismo Roma says it can be viewed from outside in the Piazza Vittorio gardens, but no page explicitly states a price or free admission.
It is an outdoor fountain in Piazza del Campidoglio. The Turismo Roma page doesn't state a price or say it is free.

The temple is inside the Roman Forum archaeological area and has no separate ticket. The cheapest official full-price ticket I confirmed that includes the Forum is the Forum Pass SUPER at €18.00, which is also the Colosseum combined ticket's full price. An italia.it listing says €16 for a 24h ticket, but that is a secondary source and may be out of date.
The official museum page and Turismo Roma didn't show an adult price. Tiqets shows only a 'from' price in USD, and a 2023 MuseoOnline page says €9, which is too old to rely on.
